newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sanyo plans to issue Y50 bln bond-sources.
newsitem.headline: Sanyo plans to issue Y50 bln bond-sources.

text.p: Sanyo Electric Co Ltd, a major manufacturer of consumer electronics, is planning to issue a total of about 50 billion yen in domestic straight bonds, market sources said on Tuesday.
The bonds are likely to come in two tranches. The first one is expected to be a 20 billion yen 10-year bond issue and the second a 30 billion yen 12-year issue.
Sanyo Electric could launch the issue this week, but much would depend on the state of the domestic bond market, they said.
